confidence_notes: I based the restaurant, coffee and beer anchors on aggregated La Spezia cost-of-living figures I found by web search, mostly crowd-sourced Numbeo-style data from mid-2026. They show about EUR 15.6 for an inexpensive meal, EUR 78 for a three-course meal for two, EUR 1.6 for a cappuccino and EUR 5.2 for a 0.5L draught beer. I raised these slightly for the July high season and for the Cinque Terre gateway premium. To convert euros to dollars I assumed about 1.16 USD per EUR, based on my general knowledge, not a searched rate. I found no aggregated local index for cocktails or wine. Those two anchors are bounded estimates built from scattered unofficial reports and from the local price relationship to beer and Italian norms: a spritz or cocktail is about EUR 8-9 and a glass of wine about EUR 5-6 in La Spezia town. Prices in the Cinque Terre villages are higher. The accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season. They do not come from live listings or searches. La Spezia has few registered hostels, so the hostel anchors are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: I compared La Spezia with mid-sized Italian coastal and port cities near major tourist areas, such as Livorno, Genoa and Salerno. La Spezia's accommodation demand in July is pushed above those cities because it is the main base for visiting the Cinque Terre.
